Build a real, playable 9:16 mobile vampire dynasty RPG blending romance, royalty, family, politics, and war. No mockups: every choice changes saved state.

CHARACTER CREATION: Choose gender, name, age, title, house, looks, personality, and power. Male portraits left, female right. Use uploaded art. Keep every face and identity unique and consistent.

NIGHT LOOP: Eight actions nightly for feeding, romance, mentoring, research, training, exploration, diplomacy, and ruling. Navigation is free. Next Night updates time, characters, resources, and events.

SANCTUARY: Enter six illustrated rooms. Bedroom: invite trusted adult partners to talk or spend the night, deepen romance, propose, and start families. Heirs' Room: speak with children, teach, train, protect, and prepare successors. Kitchen: manage blood reserves, servants, meals, and feasts. Throne Room: hear disputes, receive guests, and issue decrees. Library: discover ancient history, spells, artifacts, and powers. Ballroom: host masquerades, celebrations, romances, and diplomacy. All rooms need working actions and unique art.

RELATIONSHIPS: Create adult vampire, wolf, witch, and human NPCs with unique portraits, traits, secrets, trust, loyalty, and history. Support friendship, courtship, romance, marriage, consorts, jealousy, betrayal, and reconciliation. Romance is consensual and non-explicit. Include elite potential love interests Sia Swendy in red and Tiff Mcray in fur, matching their uploaded reference images when supplied. They may reject advances.

HEIRS: Children inherit parental looks, traits, and powers; grow to adulthood and may inherit the throne. Include rivalries, mentorship, family trees, succession. Vampire-werewolf hybrid children have special powers and may face prejudice. Always let the player defend them with guards, secrecy, treaties, training, safe havens, or council intervention; never force abandonment.

COUNCIL: Generate five different petitions each night, each offering at least three meaningful responses. Topics include blood shortages, treason, rival houses, witches, hunters, territorial claims, noble scandals, and hybrid rights. Choices affect money, stability, loyalty, and future events. No consecutive repeats.

WORLD AND WAR: Create rival vampire houses, wolf packs, covens, villages, and hunters with leaders and goals. Permit diplomacy, trade, alliances, espionage, rebellion, and warfare. Recruit guards, appoint advisors, strengthen castle defenses, and command forces. Conflict must affect casualties, finances, territory, and politics.

LIVING WORLD: NPCs age, love, marry, reproduce, feud, reconcile, inherit, and die. Remember their histories. Generate varied storylines involving romance, family, betrayals, mysteries, royal balls, political crises, and threats. Previous decisions should shape later events.

PRESENTATION: Use premium gothic art, distinct faces, rich rooms, and readable touch menus. Add optional gothic orchestral music, footsteps, thunder, wolves, fireplace sounds, and ballroom waltzes, with toggles.

SAVES: Implement manual save, autosave, load, new game, and export/import. Persist characters, relationships, choices, resources, and history across sessions.

SUCCESSION: On death or abdication, continue as an eligible heir, retaining family history, wealth, alliances, enemies, and titles. Support centuries of replayable dynasty building without a forced ending.

TECHNICAL DIRECTIVE: Use functioning HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with local storage. Make touch controls fast and reliable. Build core gameplay first, then expand. No fake buttons.

BLOODLINE: NOCTURNE. Build your bloodline. Rule the night.!!

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
